description: This Java class, TrustManagerFactoryFactory, provides methods to create and manage javax.net.ssl.TrustManagerFactory instances from various sources such as default Java CA keystore, custom PEM certificates, or insecure trust managers. It also supports optional revocation checking and integration with application-specific headers and connection details.

classes.name: TrustManagerFactoryFactory
classes.description: A utility class to generate TrustManagerFactory instances from different sources, including default Java trust store, custom certificates, and insecure configurations, with optional revocation checks and error handling.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of TrustManagerFactoryFactory with either DittoHeaders or ExceptionMapper for error handling.

methods.name: newTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Creates a TrustManagerFactory based on provided trusted certificates string and revocation checking flag.

methods.name: createTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Core method that builds TrustManagerFactory from either integrated default keystore or provided PEM certificates, with revocation options.

methods.name: loadDefaultCAKeystore
methods.description: Loads the default CA keystore from the Java runtime environment.
